propositions: The close gate's undeclared-paths refusal instructs users to declare paths and retry, but declaring them invalidates the plan-review attestation by changing the material-basis hash, making the retry fail with stale-material.

Widening file_impact is a material plan change because it retroactively broadens what an existing signature claims to cover and file_impact feeds plan-review criteria at four sites, potentially introducing new findings.

The undeclared-paths message must be clarified to state that widening file_impact requires re-attestation via rebar review-plan before the close can succeed, rather than implying a bare retry will work.

Both the undeclared-paths gate and the stale-material gate fire correctly; they jointly detect when work exceeds its reviewed scope, and the only defect is the first gate's message under-describing the required remediation.
